_comment: Provisional settings for build_onet_profiles.py; documented in docs/WORK_DESIGN.md.

releases._comment: O*NET 31.0 is the primary release. It dropped Work Values (and the old Interests file); Work Values come from 30.2, the last release that has them.

match_weights._comment: Weight of one ESCO occupation's link, split evenly over the O*NET occupations it maps to. The O*NET-hosted crosswalk has no match-type column, so every crosswalk link is 'crosswalk'.

confidence._comment: coverage confidence = min(1, ESCO occupations linked through the crosswalk / full_occupations) x share of link weight from the crosswalk route
